purpose: Auditable topic- and objective-level coverage ledger. Topic-level crosswalks do not prove that each individual objective is fully assessed.

source_catalog.completeness_note: The 73 official Suez outcome records are normalized grouped summaries. Some related source bullets have been combined; this is not yet a line-by-line transcription of every individual ILO in every supplied course specification. Complete outcome-by-outcome extraction and mapping remains a follow-up task.
source_catalog.official_source_rule: Only user-supplied Suez University Faculty of Medicine course specifications are official. External pediatric benchmarks are never counted as official Suez outcomes.

mapping_policy.direct_course_outcome: Topic is linked to one or more explicit official course outcomes; objective-level match still requires educator confirmation.
mapping_policy.partial_related_outcome: Topic has a related official outcome, but scope is not a complete match.
mapping_policy.external_benchmark_only: External undergraduate benchmark only; not an official Suez University outcome.
mapping_policy.module_only_no_specific_ilo: Module-level alignment exists but no specific course ILO was identified.
mapping_policy.not_mapped_no_verified_course_outcome: No verified course-outcome mapping has been established.
